guarantees.claim: initiated is set to 1 when hash_start_or_continue is true, cleared to 0 when hash_process or reg_hash_stop is true, and holds its previous value otherwise. Reset clears to 0.
guarantees.cond: on every posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni

assumptions.claim: hash_start_or_continue must not be asserted simultaneously with hash_process or reg_hash_stop because set takes priority and prevents the clear action.
assumptions.risk: If violated, initiated stays 1, potentially starting a new operation while a stop or process completion is requested, causing state inconsistency.

uncertain_points.claim: The priority of set (hash_start_or_continue) over clear (hash_process or reg_hash_stop) is unspecified; it is unclear whether this behavior is intended or if the driving logic guarantees mutual exclusion.
uncertain_points.cond: when both set and clear conditions are true
uncertain_points.risk: If unintended, a simultaneous start and stop could hold initiated high, disrupting the HMAC state machine and potentially causing an infinite operation or protocol violation.
